recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast studio portrait of a man in a grey suit leaning his head on his hand, set against a vibrant solid red background. The composition features heavy right-aligned typography in the upper quadrant, creating a tension between the emotional subject and the structured graphic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's downward gaze vs. upward-right text placement
Vibrant red backdrop vs. neutral grey suit tones
Tight framing of the face vs. expansive negative space on the left
Bold, blocky typography vs. the soft, organic curves of the face
coreInvariants: Subject in a grey suit with a white shirt and dark tie

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the chest and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the hand supporting the chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the arm down, then moves up to the bold text in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the red background serves as a flat stage for the subject and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the subject's clothing and skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family using weight and color (white and yellow) to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and flat-terminal look of the primary text.
Provides the necessary mid-century grotesque feel with tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man in a 1960s grey suit, white shirt, and dark tie. He is leaning his head on his hand with a sad expression, looking down. The background is a solid, vibrant vermilion red. High-contrast lighting with soft shadows on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of right-aligned text in the top right corner. The top line should be the largest in white extra-bold condensed sans-serif. The second section should be medium-sized in yellow bold condensed sans-serif. The third section should be a smaller block of white text in the same font style.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant red?
Does the man's pose convey melancholy?
Are the fonts heavy, condensed sans-serifs?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any logos or record label branding
postGenerationChecks: Check for 1960s era-appropriate clothing details (cufflinks, tie width).
Ensure the red background is uniform without texture.
Verify the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Confirm the right-alignment is perfectly vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Color Backdrop + Right-Aligned Bold Grotesque Typography = Mid-Century Melancholic Aesthetic
